footer.description: © 2024 The Ethereal Commons. Proud member of the CHATONS collective.

hero.title: The Cloud, Liberated.
hero.subtitle: Take back control of your digital life with ethical, open-source, community-managed infrastructure.
hero.verified: Verified via public proof of state on blockchain.

features.title: Designed for Transparency
features.description: We don't just host your data; we protect your free will. Our architecture is open, ethical, and built on shared values.
features.privacy_desc: No trackers, no data harvesting, no hidden telemetry. Your data remains yours, governed by the strict ethical charter of the CHATONS collective.
features.opensource_desc: Every line of code powering our infrastructure is auditable and free. No vendor lock-in, ever.
features.local_desc: We host your services on servers physically located near your community, reducing latency and environmental impact.
features.community_desc: Real humans supporting real people. Our support forum is a place for learning and mutual aid.

how_it_works.title: The Path to Sovereignty
how_it_works.step1_desc: Create an account and choose your membership level. We are a non-profit association; your contributions go directly to maintenance.
how_it_works.step2_desc: One-click deployment for ethical alternatives to Big Tech: Nextcloud, Mastodon, Peertube, and more.
how_it_works.step3_desc: Connect your custom domain and start sharing your content without the baggage of surveillance capitalism.

cta.title: Ready to leave the black boxes?
cta.subtitle: Join Ethereal Commons today and support a decentralized and ethical web for all.

about.title: Our Manifesto
about.subtitle: For technology in the service of humans, not profit.
about.intro: Ethereal Commons was born from a simple observation: today's web is broken. Centralized, surveilled, and excessively monetized, it no longer serves the interests of its users. We offer an alternative.

values.sovereignty_desc: You must have total control over your tools and your data.
values.cooperation_desc: We are a commons. Each member participates in the resilience of the whole.
values.frugality_desc: We optimize our services to minimize their ecological impact.

pricing.title: Fair Participation
pricing.subtitle: No profit, just the real cost of infrastructure and humans.

nomade.name: Nomad
nomade.desc: Ideal for starting your journey towards sovereignty.

services.title: Your Free Ecosystem
services.subtitle: All the tools you need, without compromising your privacy.

list.cloud_desc: File storage, calendar, contacts, and online document editing.
list.mail_desc: Messaging service without ads or content analysis.
list.chat_desc: Secure and federated instant messaging via the Matrix protocol.
list.video_desc: Private meetings with no time limit using Jitsi Meet.
list.form_desc: Collect data in a respectful and secure way.
list.dev_desc: Manage your software projects with a GitLab or Forgejo instance.

signup.title: Join the Collective
signup.subtitle: Ethical technology, community-managed, for free minds. Create your space today.
signup.pack_desc: Select the essential services for your ecosystem.
signup.tos_note: By signing up, you agree to our Ethical Charter and our Privacy Policy.
